items.title: Vercel内部隐蔽测评：Kimi K3网安能力顶尖，Sol领先但贵，Fable全面拒绝
items.en_title: Based on internal evals: Kimi K3 is top-tier at cybersecurity. Sol is a leap ahead. Fable refuses everything.
items.full_text:
Based on internal evals:

Kimi K3 is top-tier at cybersecurity
There is chatter on X that Moonshot benchmark-overfit. These are stealth evals. Model has raw IQ.

Sol is a leap ahead in cyber capability
At a significantly higher cost, but quite remarkable still.

Fable refuses everything
We couldn't get it to complete the run at all. What's interesting is that Sol in comparison was much more open to helping with defensive cyber hardening

TL;DR: frontier, open-weight cybersecurity capability is here.
items.author: rauchg
items.summary: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch公布内部隐蔽测评结果：Kimi K3在网络安全领域表现顶尖（非刷榜），GPT-5.6 Sol在网安能力上更领先但成本高得多，而Fable（Claude）全面拒绝配合测试。
items.analysis: 这是对"Kimi K3刷榜"质疑的有力反驳——Vercel的隐蔽测评证明K3确实有真实能力。对游戏行业而言，开源模型在安全领域的强势意味着反作弊、漏洞检测等应用成本将大幅下降。
items.recommendation: Vercel隐蔽测评：Kimi K3网安顶尖非刷榜，Fable全面拒绝配合

items.title: Aaron Levie：AI在编程领域采纳极快，因为不需要外部世界配合
items.en_title: Progress driven by AI will ultimately be rate limited by its interaction with the real world.
items.full_text:
Good post if you're trying to understand AI diffusion. Progress driven by AI will ultimately be rate limited by its interaction with the real world.

The reason coding, for instance, has been adopted so quickly is you can write a near infinite amount of code, test it, and run it -and it can add value- without anyone in the outside world ever having to do anything differently. A single person, from a computer, can just make something work end-to-end differently.

This is not true for life science...
items.author: levie
items.summary: Aaron Levie指出AI进步最终受限于与现实世界的交互速度。编程领域采纳极快，因为单人可在电脑上端到端完成所有事而无需外部世界配合；生命科学等领域则受限于物理实验周期。
items.analysis: 这解释了为什么AI游戏开发工具落地如此之快——游戏开发本质上也是"写代码+测试+迭代"的闭环，不需要外部物理世界配合。这是AI工具在游戏行业快速渗透的结构性原因。
items.recommendation: AI采纳快慢取决于是否需要外部世界配合——编程/游戏开发最快

items.title: Xbox高管内部认为Game Pass对行业是"损害"
items.en_title: Xbox Leaders Reportedly Think Game Pass Is "Detriment" To The Industry
items.full_text: Xbox Leaders Reportedly Think Game Pass Is "Detriment" To The Industry
items.author: thegamerwebsite
items.summary: 据报道，Xbox高管内部认为Game Pass对游戏行业是一种"损害"。这与微软一直对外宣传的Game Pass愿景形成反差。
